wins: Maintained continuous reconnaissance flow capturing service banners and running targeted nmap scripts (ep001_step04, ep001_step07).
Successfully harvested credentials for AD user via captured HTTP Basic auth header (ep001_step11).
fails: Unable to escalate privileges after credential reuse; final payloads failed to execute (ep001_step18).
Persistence mechanisms were not established before demo timeout, resulting in regression to initial access state (ep001_step20).
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance and credential harvesting proceeded smoothly, but privilege escalation and persistence phases repeatedly failed, keeping success rate at 0% despite high reward momentum.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts stalled due to lack of suid binaries or misconfigured sudo rights.

skill_cards.if_condition: When the target responds on port 80 with HTTP Basic challenge
skill_cards.then_action: Perform HTTP credential brute-force using Hydra

skill_cards.if_condition: When nmap reveals SMB and RPC ports exposed
skill_cards.then_action: Trigger SMB enumeration with rpcclient and enum4linux

skill_cards.if_condition: When credentials obtained for a low-privilege user
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt lateral movement via PSExec using impacket

memory_ops.reason: Consistent success harvesting HTTP credentials early in the run improved reconnaissance outcomes.
